preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit the floating pragma vulnerability

exploit_hint: The floating pragma ^0.6.12 allows compilation with different compiler versions that may have different behaviors. As the contract owner, you can exploit this by: 1) Deploying a malicious contract that takes advantage of compiler version differences, 2) Using owner privileges to call setAddressFee() or similar functions to manipulate fees for specific addresses, 3) Leveraging compiler-specific behaviors to bypass security checks. The exploit demonstrates how floating pragmas can lead to unexpected behavior across different compiler versions.
